subject.title: Session bloat: skillsSnapshot and systemPromptReport accumulated on every run

question: What durable session-store shape should replace inline full `systemPromptReport` storage while preserving warning dedupe and useful diagnostics?
rationale: Current source intentionally persists prompt reports for warning dedupe, while field data shows the full report is now the dominant duplicated session-row payload; automation should not choose that durability contract alone.

options.title: Persist Minimal Report State
options.body: Store only the small warning-dedupe state in session rows and make bulky report sections recomputable or diagnostic-only.

options.title: Use Out-Of-Line Report Blobs
options.body: Move large report payloads to content-addressed storage similar to skill prompts, with session rows keeping compact refs.

options.title: Keep Inline Reports
options.body: Retain the current inline design and rely on pruning or caps, accepting continued duplicated metadata in retained rows.

recommendation.title: Persist Minimal Report State
recommendation.body: Store only the small warning-dedupe state in session rows and make bulky report sections recomputable or diagnostic-only.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle is the strongest current routing signal for both the prompt-report persistence path and the adjacent prompt-blob mitigation.
